{{Libra}}
Libra 21 is the 301st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 21st day of Libra, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 43, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮21日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 301|Chapter 301]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152320}}.
